Package com.example.projecteventlotteryapp.dbUtils

Class EventUtils

java.lang.Object
com.example.projecteventlotteryapp.dbUtils.EventUtils
public class EventUtils extends Object
Utility class to provide database operations on the Event class

This class is designed to encapsulated all database operates for Events. An instance of this class should be declared with an injection of the database instance that the operations are performed on.

Example usage: EventUtils eventUtils = new EventUtils(FirebaseFirestore.getInstance());

    • addToEntrantList

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> addToEntrantList(EntrantListType listType, String entrantID, String eventId)
      Adds an entrant to a specified entrant list for this event.

      This method updates the Firestore event document by adding the entrant's user ID to the corresponding list field using FieldValue.arrayUnion. If the user ID already exists in the list, Firestore will not add a duplicate.

      Parameters:
      listType - the entrant list to which the user should be added
      entrantID - the ID of the user being added to the list
      Returns:
      a Task representing the asynchronous Firestore update operation

      This function updates the Firestore event document by removing an entrant's userID from the corresponding list field using FieldValue.arrayRemove.

    • moveEntrantAcrossLists

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> moveEntrantAcrossLists(String eventId, String entrantId, EntrantListType toList, EntrantListType fromList)
      This function moves a single entrant to toList from fromList

      This function moves a single entrant across two lists. Using this method is preferred to using the addToEntrantList and removeFromEntrantList together because it guarantees atomicity. ie. ensures that both lists are simultaneously updated. Note: MUST be sure that the entrantId is already in the toList.

      Parameters:
      eventId - eventId of the event
      entrantId - id of the user to be moved
      toList - the EntrantListType of the list the user is currently in
      fromList - the EntrantListType of the list the user is moving to
      Returns:

    • createNewEventDbItem

      public void createNewEventDbItem(Event event, String organizerId)
      Creates and uploads a new Event database object

      Uses an Event instance and uploads it to the database. Only populates the following attributes: organizer name drawDate registrationEndDate registrationStartDate drawDate entrantsLimit All other values are initialized to null or the equivalent default value

      This function is ONLY to be used to create a new Event db entry with the values required at creation. This is to ensure all initial values are set accordingly. Further event attribute refinements are handled using the associated Event db entry update methods.

      Parameters:
      event - the Event that is to be uploaded
      organizerId - the user ID of the organizer of the event

    • generateInvitationList

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> generateInvitationList(String eventId, int entrantsLimit)
      Generates the InvitationList for an event, or adds new entrants if it already exists

      This function populates the Invited list for an event based on how many free spaces exist. It first gets the users in the waitlist as well as the size of the invited list before creating a random sample of the waitlist and moving all users from the sampled list into the invitedList.

      Parameters:
      eventId - the id of the event to generate the invited list for
      entrantsLimit - the number of amount of entrants that are allowed to be in the invited list. Must be greater than 0
      Returns:
      a task

    • sampleEntrantList

      public ArrayList<String> sampleEntrantList(ArrayList<String> waitlist, int entrantsLimit, int invitedListSize)
      Randomly samples an arrayList of Strings

      This function is used to randomly sample an ArrayList that represents the waitlist of an event to return a partial invited list. It subtracts invitedListSize from entrantsLimit to determine the size of the ArrayList of random entrants to return

      Parameters:
      waitlist - an ArrayList of userIds on a waitlist
      entrantsLimit - The amount of entrants allowed to enroll in an event
      invitedListSize - the size of the associated invitedList, used to calculate return size
      Returns:
      an ArrayList of randomly sampled users given via the waitlist of size entrantsLimit - invitedListSize

    • addCommentToEvent

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentReference> addCommentToEvent(String eventID, Map<String,Object> newComment)
      Adds a comment to the event

      This function is used to add a new comment to the comments collection in the database, as well as updates the array of comment ID strings in the event. It returns a document reference task so that the comment document ID can be referenced after it's been added. NOTE: the new comment must contain the comment text, the timestamp of the comment, and the ID of the user who made the comment.

      Parameters:
      eventID - ID of the event that the comment is being added onto.
      newComment - A hashmap object of a new comment, includes the text, timestamp, and user ID of the commenter
      Returns:
      a task containing the document reference of the new comment in the comments collection
